Sam (eng-platform): Postmortem follow-up: we need concrete owners for rollout safeguards (auto-rollback, blast-radius caps, pacing). Tracker: https://internal/redwood/rollout-safeguards
Lina (eng-sre): I'll take auto-rollback. Simple detector: error_rate + latency spike => rollback. Hysteresis: 3 windows + 10m cooldown. RFC by 2026-03-30.
Carlos (product): I'll own blast-radius caps + console controls. Proposal: default slices [1%,10%,50%], org allowlist, and a pause button. Mock by 2026-03-28.
Priya (oncall): Need rollout pacing enforcement in router to prevent >50% jumps. Sam can you add admission check?
Sam (eng-platform): Yep. I'll add admission check + enforcement rule. ETA 2026-04-05. Also adding weekly recurring-pattern job to tag deployments with >2 incidents/30d. Lina to implement alerts.
Lina (eng-sre): Will add Prom rule and low-sev PD test channel.
Sam (eng-platform): Summary: Lina auto-rollback & alerts (2026-03-30/2026-03-31), Carlos UI caps (2026-03-28), Sam pacing admission (2026-04-05). Sync Friday 10am. Please drop PR links into the tracker. :thumbsup:
